notes.title: Parasight Chlorophyll worms🪰 have just been launched.
notes.notes:
[h3]🥳A great day for Parasight fans.
[b]Parasight Chlorophyll worms🪰[/b] have just been launched.[/h3]
Ready for a long and rich adventure? 
No wait, let's play!!!

[previewyoutube=jmtvnoo4AU8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In [b]Parasight: Chlorophyll Worms,[/b][/h3] you will play as a little girl who wants to save herself from a dangerous biological virus as she faces various difficulties and hardships in her journey.

Far away in the galaxy, there was an Earth-like planet called Velasterham. The story begins in a quiet-peaceful country named Bonrham that was created by 40 united cities. Everyone's Life was simple and sweet.

In a large old house, a girl and her family lived. On a normal sunny day, she goes out of the city to see her friend and play with him. After a lovely day, when they wanted to go back home, suddenly they saw a strange plant! After that, the girl's life turned upside down. Seems like a virus spreading in Bonrham, as we call it...
Parasight: Chlorophyll Worms features two types of currency: the energy extract which can only be obtained by killing enemies, or by injection with energy syringes; and the 2-Clay coin which can be obtained by doing tasks or looting.

Vanquish enemies while you level up to become stronger and buy new items like weapons, armor, rings, consumables, and many more to make your fights easier. Wear heavy armor and use weighty weapons or wear light armor, use quick weapons like daggers or blades.

Explore the vast Bonrham cities, talk to people and listen to their stories, discover cool secrets and items... or you can just ignore them, killing everyone and finding your way out. And finally, test your IQ and try to solve the tasks of Tefras to guide your way to your unpredictable fate!

[h3]Key Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unique art and soundtrack.
[*] More than 250 battle items.
[*] Includes swords, axes, staves, bows, shields, etc.
[*] Two types of currency: energy extract and clay coin.
[*] Vanquish enemies and level up to become stronger.
[*] Buy new items like weapons, armor, rings, consumables, and many more.
[*] Play with your satisfying techniques.
[*] Wear heavy and light armors and use weighty or quick weapons.
[*] Utilize ranged weapons or fight with the magic spells.
[*] Explore the vast Bonrham cities, talk to people or ignore them and kill everybody.
[*] Test your IQ and try to solve the tasks of Tefras.
[/list]
